text: Standing in this thoughtfully designed, modern environment, I feel a sense of inquisitiveness and possibility. The clean glass walls and the presence of technology invite me to reflect on knowledge, progress, and the ways humans strive to shape the future. The "R+D" exhibit sparks a philosophical curiosity about innovation and our place within ever-evolving systems. There’s a subtle energy here—a reminder that every discovery is both an answer and a new question waiting to unfold.
